summary: Refined the Tikbalang walk motion in init.luau to add grounded torso vertical staging, phase-derived weight shifts, smooth joint arcs using squared sine lift envelopes, and secondary head overlap settling without modifying root motion or joint hierarchy.
expectedEffect: Torso and head now exhibit realistic weight-based vertical descent and counter-sway during locomotion, replacing uniform sine oscillation with a grounded support rhythm.

function Motion.walk(form,bones,time)
 local state="walk"
 local result={}
 for name in pairs(bones)do result[name]={x=0,y=0,z=0,rx=0,ry=0,rz=0}end
 local function pose(name,x,y,z,rx,ry,rz)
  if result[name]then result[name]={x=x or 0,y=y or 0,z=z or 0,rx=rx or 0,ry=ry or 0,rz=rz or 0}end
 end
 local moving=state=="walk" or state=="chase"
 local speed=state=="chase" and 10 or moving and 6 or 2
 local phase=time*speed;local wave=math.sin(phase);local breathe=math.sin(time*2)
 local floating=form=="SHROUD" or form=="FLOATING_HEAD" or form=="OBJECT_SWARM" or form=="RIBBON" or form=="LANTERN"
 pose("Torso",0,floating and math.sin(time*2.4)*.13 or .03*breathe,0,0,moving and wave*.025 or breathe*.015,0)
 pose("Head",0,0,0,breathe*.035,math.sin(time*.9)*.07,0)

function Motion.walk(form,bones,time)
 local state="walk"
 local result={}
 for name in pairs(bones)do result[name]={x=0,y=0,z=0,rx=0,ry=0,rz=0}end
 local function pose(name,x,y,z,rx,ry,rz)
  if result[name]then result[name]={x=x or 0,y=y or 0,z=z or 0,rx=rx or 0,ry=ry or 0,rz=rz or 0}end
 end
 local moving=state=="walk" or state=="chase"
 local speed=state=="chase" and 10 or moving and 6 or 2
 local phase=time*speed;local wave=math.sin(phase);local breathe=math.sin(time*2)
 local lift=math.max(0,math.sin(phase))^2
 local sway=math.sin(phase*2)
 local floating=form=="SHROUD" or form=="FLOATING_HEAD" or form=="OBJECT_SWARM" or form=="RIBBON" or form=="LANTERN"
 pose("Torso",0,floating and math.sin(time*2.4)*.13 or -.08+.03*math.cos(phase*2),0,0,moving and wave*.04 or breathe*.015,0)
 pose("Head",0,0,0,breathe*.035+lift*.05,math.sin(time*.9)*.07-sway*.05,0)
